topic.angle: Agriculture arose in several places and changed how people lived

body.question: Farming began in the Fertile Crescent roughly 10,000 years ago. Did it start there once and spread everywhere, or arise in several places?
options: It started once and spread everywhere
It arose separately in several parts of the world
body.reveal: Domestication of plants and animals happened in separate places around the world, beginning about 11,700 years ago after the last Ice Age. In the Fertile Crescent it began around 10,000 to 8,000 BCE, and perhaps around 8000 BCE in Papua New Guinea. It turned small mobile groups of hunter-gatherers into settled villages and towns.

probes.question: What did the Neolithic Revolution change about how people lived?
options: Nomadic hunter-gatherers became settled societies in villages and towns
Cities were first built at sea
People moved from farms to caves

probes.question: True or false: farming was invented in one place and then spread to the entire world.

claims.quote: dated from 10,000 to 8,000 BCE in the Fertile Crescent , and perhaps 8000 BCE in the Kuk Early Agricultural Site of Papua New Guinea
